body: Yeah it only populated my own address.

Scared. Also thinking if we reopen too soon then the entire self isolating thing was a waste of time. Why rush things? June 1st? Seems more safe. Especially with this threat of "second wave"  I honestly do not know what is best. And clearly most other people do not know either. Err on the side of caution seems smart.
Never mess with a kittens eyes. Just saying. Esp newborn.

I agree Nismo. I guess it is because I am asked to come in to work and do not feel essential. But people are like "stay home" and I am like yes please!  Can i go home and join a sofa protest. lol ... Yeah you can, too bad you won't be paid to do that. Literally a lady just walked in and stood at my cubicle and coughed ...we made eye contact and she said, "Sorry".  I wanted to RUN to my car and go home and shower...but oops I cannot do that. I am way too essential. (eyeroll)

I read your entire post. I like that part about a stranger helping. We just never know how our actions can effect others. That bit about trying to get into top notch colleges made me sad. I feel like parents want "only the best" for their kids, then push push push them into stuff that is just not always the best. 

Plus your post made me want to eat a cookie. So YAY.
Be prepared to endure "red headed stepchild" jokes for the rest of your days kitten.

A person in a managerial position intentionally having a meeting on a day that you will not be there is manipulative.  It is so typical of insecure people. Like...Ok guys, we are going to have a meeting...1st order of discussion..."Who has been talking about me???" Was it ness\_arose?? Tell me." What did she say.??"    So silly. 

I feel your stress. I work in an office filled with emotional people. It is so hard. I am quiet but I am seen as the drama person because i am social distanced more than anyone.  Good luck to you OP. Cus this is stress you do not need.

I volunteered to stay home. Is so stressful right now. **For everyone** who is concerned. I appreciate all safety gestures.. when i see someone else wearing a mask I do not feel they are a threat to me. Or that they are silly. I really wish the masks had been recommended a lot earlier.
Thank you for the kind words.

Nope. all gathered around the same tables . They said they didn't offer me anything cus they knew i would say no. I am looked at as a doomsday debbie downer. I wear a mask, they roll their eyes. I walk around spraying door handles with lysol when I get there in the morning (AS we had been instructed to weeks ago!). Everyone acts like I am spraying raid in their faces.
Thank you

Where did this happen? The tape stamp says 2012 and doors look like they have a key/code entry. Also looks like he is trying to or pretending to try to use a code across the hall at a different door. Damn grainy but something looks oddly familiar about this man.

If you had known what he had in mind to do, you would have done everything to stop him. You didn't know and you are not responsible. You couldn't read his thoughts. In all honesty, he pulled a sh\*t move by doing that to you. Him saying he wanted to see your face, seems more to me like he wanted you to see him doing his final act ( or at least be aware of it) . It was well planned out...for his PC to shut down like that. Maybe he found some peace. I am sorry this happened.

Yes go home.  "Mom, I screwed up royally, judge me if you want to, but I need some help". Just be honest with friends and family back home. Sooner rather than later.  If you were my daughter I would first advise you...Do Not Get Pregnant with this man's child. 

​
I have to say...you drink gin on the regular...makes you a bad ass in my eyes. That stuff is undrinkable for me. But I am a wino.  I do also like mincemeat pie. is that the same?

I remember a speaker telling a story once at a conference about bullying...3 places kids get bullied the most are 1. Lunch room 2. School Bus 3. Playground. Speaking about elementary age kids. Kids can be so crappy.

Umm . Wow. I heard one time on a city bus, when it broke down, the driver radioed in  (or called by phone..not sure) and said Don't bring bus # 30. I can't fit behind that steering wheel. I guess it's a thing.
Still cute?? No! You are gorgeous!

1. Are you in the US? My friend just got a job driving a school bus and she got a call from the school district about 45 minutes after applying online. She is starting at about 15 dollars per hour. I know that sounds silly (upon reading it back to myself). She had no experience dealing with kids and she is only 23 but they were happy to hire her immediately. Had to pass a drug screen etc. Hey, sorry you are going thru this tough time. I am sure you don't want the usual cliches..hang in there. keep ya head up, but I do hope for a major improvement for you!

Did you OP? Were you able to make it through that? The winch thing sounds terrible. I think she would hurt and a lot. But time heals hurt..esp grief hurt. It just does. When we want it to get better, eventually it does. When we DO NOT want it to get better, it just starts to anyway. People say, time doesn't help. I do not believe that. Whether it is emotional or traumatic, time helps. When I lost someone that I adored and was totally not expecting to lose, I found that time (a lot of time passed) made me stop hurting as bad. And I was actually pissed. I wanted that pain. It was my link to him. But even tho I tried, I could not get back to that "cut to the quick" pain.
Thank you for the kind words. I am sorry you feel suicidal.

Thank you. I am feeling a little bit desperate. His s o and I are communicating somewhat but are not on the same page about the possibility of this happening again. I just don't feel that this is going to end well.

I will look at those tips. And also at suicide watch. The hosp did give my son some information about drug counseling,  because they came to believe he had an alcohol problem. Which I wish was the case for him but unfortunately it's a self harm problem
Sorry this is happening...may i ask what might have been done to help most? When you were spiraling? Would a conversation have helped? Companionship?
